description: Shared ff-screen-model framed-table bands: draw each model.tables entry INSIDE the frame's own ruled bands (not a nested box) in the framed (header_lines) render path, per screen-snapshot-scrm Req 30.32-30.40 / tasks Phase 2I. This is the renderer half every table-editor Kind (Alias first, then Menu/Kinds/Keys/Theme) inherits. Independent of FEAT-002; FEAT-003 depends on it.
steps: TDD: in crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/framed_tests.rs (and framed_rule_tests.rs) write FAILING tests: a framed model with one table draws a top rule with a tee-down at each column divider, a header band, a header/data rule with crosses, one band per data row, and the Content_Area closing rule with tee-up per divider; NO blank spacer row and NO caption row inside the box; column width = widest of header and all cells; a table with no rows draws header band + rules only; a table with no columns is omitted.
TDD: write FAILING tests that two tables, or a table following body_lines/fields, lay out one after another with adjacent rules COALESCED (never two consecutive rules).

TDD: write a FAILING test that the grid's own top rule MERGES with the frame-owned rule the shell draws between the Command ===> line and the first content row (exactly one rule carrying the header tee-down junctions), and likewise the grid bottom rule merges with the rule above the status band; a Content_Area with no grid renders the plain frame rule as before.

TDD: write FAILING tests that a cell containing ' | ' stays inside its cell (not re-split on the band separator); tab/CR/LF in a cell render as a single space and are never read as the RIGHT_ALIGN marker; the ASCII fallback (unicode_box=false) yields the equivalent layout using only + - |.

Implement the table-band layout in crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/framed.rs::collect_rows: replace the current per-table 'Row::Text(blank) + Row::Text(caption) + render_table_grid lines' emission with Row::Rule/GridTop + Row::Band(headers) + Row::Rule(cross) + one Row::Band per data row, reusing the existing Row/compose_band/push_rule/lay_row/merge_top_rule/push_bottom_bands/grid_rule_cuts machinery (no second junction mechanism). Keep caption available to Markdown/HTML (not drawn in the box).
If framed.rs would exceed 400 non-test lines, split the new band-layout helpers into a new crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/framed_bands.rs and keep framed.rs a thin coordinator.
Add a guard test that render/text.rs::render_plain for a model WITHOUT header_lines still emits the below-the-frame render_table_grid byte-for-byte (legacy path UNCHANGED, Req 30.39).

Add/confirm a test that render/markdown.rs (and html.rs) with non-empty markdown_sections emits the fenced box FIRST then the sections and nothing else, and is unchanged for a model without them (Req 30.40, 2I.4).
acceptance_criteria: A framed model with a table renders as frame-ruled bands (top tee-down rule, header band, cross rule, data bands, tee-up closing rule), with no blank spacer row, no caption row inside the box, and grid rules merged with the frame rules above/below -- asserted by the new framed_tests/framed_rule_tests.
Cells are discrete (' | ' stays in-cell; control chars become a space) and the ASCII fallback uses only + - |.
The legacy render_plain path (no header_lines) still emits render_table_grid byte-for-byte; the markdown_sections clipboard path is box-first then sections.

`cargo test -p ff-screen-model render::framed` and the new test names pass; `cargo clippy -p ff-screen-model -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt -p ff-screen-model -- --check` are clean; every touched .rs stays under 400 non-test lines.
verification: cargo check -p ff-screen-model  (redirect to a unique _ignore/logs/ log; read it back)
cargo test -p ff-screen-model render::framed  (and the new framed_tests / framed_rule_tests names)
findings: Implemented in crates/ff-screen-model. Framed tables now render as frame-ruled BANDS, not a nested box. KEY DESIGN for later steps: the table-band layout did NOT need the Row::GridTop/GridBottom/merge_top_rule machinery -- that stays ONLY for the synthetic body_lines-grid path exercised by framed_rule_tests.rs. Instead, a tables entry is emitted as real Row::Band rows and the EXISTING push_rule junction logic derives tee-down/cross/tee-up automatically from the adjacent bands: the frame boundary rule already pushed before content_start becomes the merged top rule (tee-down from the header band below), and push_bottom_bands' closing rule becomes the tee-up/status-tee-down merged rule. Files: (1) NEW crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/framed_bands.rs -- pure table_bands(table)->Option<TableBands> that computes per-column widths (widest of header + all cells), sanitises control chars (tab/CR/LF->space, so a tab is never read as the RIGHT_ALIGN marker), pads each cell to its column width, and returns None for a no-column table (omitted). Registered as `mod framed_bands;` in render.rs. (2) framed.rs::collect_rows -- replaced the old per-table 'blank Row::Text + caption Row::Text + render_table_grid lines' emission with push_table_bands(): maybe_push_rule (coalesces adjacent rules) + Row::Band(header) + Row::Rule(cross) + one Row::Band per data row. Removed the now-unused render_table_grid import from framed.rs (it stays used by the LEGACY text.rs path, unchanged). framed.rs non-test = 396 lines (<400). caption is intentionally NOT drawn in the framed box -- it remains available to Markdown/HTML flavors. Tests: crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/framed_table_tests.rs (NEW, registered in render.rs) -- 10 tests covering band structure + junctions (30.32/30.34), column alignment (30.33), no-rows header-band-only + no-columns-omitted + coalescing + table-after-body (30.37), discrete cells + control-char flattening (30.36), ASCII fallback (30.38), legacy render_plain unchanged guard (30.39), and markdown_sections box-first guard (30.40). framed_bands.rs has 5 unit tests for the pure reducer. VERIFICATION (compile-only, agent): cargo check / clippy -D warnings / fmt --check all clean; cargo test -p ff-screen-model render:: = 59 passed, 0 failed (16 new + 43 pre-existing render tests, no regression in framed_tests/framed_rule_tests/text/markdown/html). FEAT-003 (live Alias/other Kinds consuming this) can rely on: a model that sets header_lines + tables now yields frame-band tables with merged rules; NO ScreenModel/Table shape change was made (30.17 holds). FEAT-002 is independent.
